"""Review actual compiled source/recipe closure without rebuilding or using GPU."""
from pathlib import Path
import fcntl
import hashlib
import importlib.util
import json
import shlex

B = Path('/home/yayoi/.local/state/strata-sycl/post-reboot-tuning-20261007')
W = Path('/home/yayoi/ghq/github.com/yqYo1/Strata/.worktree/diag-native-copy-queue-qualified-20261013')
O = B / 'xe-llvm-v711-source-v5/direct_owner.py'
assert hashlib.sha256(O.read_bytes()).hexdigest() == 'a29d8257eecc77c4ad9ae6671d092b56f4c09a35c4247c125fed3a8c8bc1f95f'
SPEC = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('copy_compile_closure_owner', O)
M = importlib.util.module_from_spec(SPEC)
SPEC.loader.exec_module(M)
build_path = B / 'main-native-copy-queue-build-root-v2/record.json'
build = json.loads(build_path.read_text())
first_path = B / 'main-native-copy-queue-build-root-v1/record.json'
first = json.loads(first_path.read_text())
assert all(d['passed'] and d['complete'] and not d['active'] for d in (build, first))
ENV = build['environment']


def pin(path):
    return dict(path=str(path), sha256=M.sha(path))


def dump(path, value):
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    path.write_text(json.dumps(value, indent=2) + '\n')


with (B / 'owned-v0141-measurement.lock').open('a') as lock:
    fcntl.flock(lock, fcntl.LOCK_EX | fcntl.LOCK_NB)
    out = B / 'main-native-copy-model-source-closure-root-v1'
    assert not out.exists()
    out.mkdir()
    r = dict(active=True, passed=False, complete=False, main_reviewed=True, commands=[], evidence={},
             gpu_executed=False, model_executed=False, candidate_tree=str(W),
             candidate_revision='410904c99d273435b5302fa8976cc667d17957f2',
             original_build_receipt=pin(build_path), original_first_build_receipt=pin(first_path),
             binary=build['binaries']['free']['strata'])

    def save():
        dump(out / 'record.json', r)

    owner = M.Owner(out / 'commands', save)
    r['commands'] = owner.commands

    def run(label, argv, wall=60):
        c, so, se = owner.run(label, argv, ENV, W, wall=wall, cpu=600,
                             rss_cap=2 << 30, text_cap=8 << 20, total_cap=32 << 20)
        stdout, stderr = so.read_text(), se.read_text()
        r['evidence'][label] = dict(stdout=stdout, stderr=stderr)
        save()
        assert M.closed(c) and c['session_anchored'] and c['exit_code'] == 0, label
        return stdout

    try:
        assert run('head', ['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD']).strip() == r['candidate_revision']
        assert not run('status', ['git', 'status', '--porcelain', '--untracked-files=all']).strip()
        files = run('source-inventory', ['git', 'ls-files', 'src', 'include', 'cmake', 'CMakeLists.txt']).splitlines()
        files = [p for p in files if Path(p).suffix in ('.cpp', '.hpp', '.h', '.inc', '.cu', '.cuh', '.cmake', '.txt')]
        r['source_pins'] = {p: M.sha(W / p) for p in files}
        assert len(r['source_pins']) > 48
        assert all(r['source_pins'].get(p) == h for p, h in build['source_pins'].items() if p.startswith(('src/', 'include/')) or p == 'CMakeLists.txt')
        r['source_pins'].update(build['source_pins'])
        for p, digest in r['source_pins'].items():
            assert M.sha(W / p) == digest
        commands_path = W / 'build/free/compile_commands.json'
        commands = json.loads(commands_path.read_text())
        relevant = ['src/core/device.cpp', 'src/core/gpu.cpp', 'src/prefill/prefill.cpp', 'src/program/generate.cpp']
        r['compiled_translation_units'] = []
        r['actual_relevant_compile_commands'] = {}
        r['actual_prior_recompilation_lines'] = {}
        for name in relevant:
            rows = [c for c in commands if Path(c['file']).resolve() == (W / name).resolve()]
            assert len(rows) == 1
            r['actual_relevant_compile_commands'][name] = rows[0]
            r['compiled_translation_units'].append(name)
            lines = [s for d in (first, build) for s in d['evidence']['build-free']['stdout'].splitlines()
                     if 'Building CXX object ' in s and name + '.o' in s]
            assert lines
            r['actual_prior_recompilation_lines'][name] = lines
        dry = run('ninja-current-source-dry-run', ['/usr/bin/ninja', '-C', str(W / 'build/free'), '-n', 'strata'])
        assert 'ninja: no work to do.' in dry and 'Building ' not in dry
        deps = run('actual-object-header-dependencies', ['/usr/bin/ninja', '-C', str(W / 'build/free'), '-t', 'deps'])
        assert all(p in deps for p in ['include/strata/core/runtime.hpp', 'include/strata/core/native_copy_lifetime.hpp',
                                     'include/strata/core/copy_stream_policy.hpp', 'include/strata/core/gpu.hpp'])
        actual = run('actual-compile-and-link-recipe', ['/usr/bin/ninja', '-C', str(W / 'build/free'), '-t', 'commands', 'strata'])
        assert all(name in actual for name in relevant)
        assert str(W / 'build/free/strata') in actual or '-o strata' in actual
        compiler = Path(shlex.split(r['actual_relevant_compile_commands'][relevant[0]]['command'])[0])
        r['compiler'] = pin(compiler)
        r['compiler_macro_configuration'] = {name: [x for x in shlex.split(c['command']) if x.startswith(('-D', '-U', '-O', '-f'))]
                                               for name, c in r['actual_relevant_compile_commands'].items()}
        assert all('-DNDEBUG' in flags and '-O3' in flags for flags in r['compiler_macro_configuration'].values())
        r['compile_commands'] = pin(commands_path)
        r['recipe_pins'] = {name: pin(W / 'build/free' / name) for name in ['build.ninja', 'CMakeCache.txt', '.ninja_deps']}
        for name in ['actual-object-header-dependencies', 'actual-compile-and-link-recipe']:
            target = out / (name + '.txt')
            target.write_text(r['evidence'][name]['stdout'])
            r['recipe_pins'][name] = pin(target)
        assert M.sha(Path(r['binary']['path'])) == r['binary']['sha256']
        r.update(compiled_source_recipe_verified=True, complete_main_helper_closure_verified=True,
                 compile_commands_translation_units_verified=True, compiler_macro_configuration_verified=True,
                 relevant_translation_units_recompiled=True, relevant_header_dependencies_verified=True,
                 actual_link_recipe_verified=True, passed=True, complete=True)
    except BaseException as error:
        r['error'] = repr(error)
    finally:
        r.update(active=owner.active is not None, finished_utc=M.utc())
        save()
    print(json.dumps({k: r.get(k) for k in ['passed', 'error', 'candidate_revision']}))
    raise SystemExit(0 if r['passed'] else 1)
